name: Guidewheel Account
description: A Guidewheel FactoryOps tenant, connected via base URL and API key.

fields.label: Display name
fields.description: Optional label, useful when several plants or tenants are connected

fields.label: Tenant base URL
fields.description: Tenant-specific — delivered together with your API key. Paste it as issued; a trailing /api/v1 is accepted either way

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Company-scoped key, sent as the x-api-key header. Only sees data belonging to your company

fields.label: Company ID
fields.placeholder: Optional — the key is already company-scoped
fields.description: Sent as the company_id query parameter on every call. Only needed when your key spans more than one company

keyDescription: Guidewheel provisions API access per company — there is no developer portal. Ask your Guidewheel contact for the tenant base URL, the API key, and (on request) a sandbox tenant.
